description: The same fourth engine as `ci-image-without-engine` — `chrome`, collected on every spec — and this time the gates job installs it, with a step that names it beside the three every step names. Point 5 has nothing to refuse: the image carries three engines and the step the fourth. The first version of the image rule refused it anyway, and told the reader to add the very step that was there. So the case goes on to point 6, which has no probe result for an engine it cannot launch here, and that is where it stops — the rule it declares is the proof that point 5 let it through.

chrome.$why: A branded channel of blink, installed by a step beside the image.

ciText:
jobs:
  # Playwright's image, mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, at the lockfile's version.
  gates:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: npx playwright install chrome chromium firefox webkit
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected -t lint test build check-browsers
  e2e:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }} -t e2e
